ITEM.PTXT: With ACC or IG ON, operating the volume adjustment buttons ("Up" or "Down" button) allows the volume of the voice guidance from the Toll Collection (ETC) Computer Assembly to be adjusted (8 levels) or muted. When the volume adjustment button is pushed while no voice guidance is in progress, the voice guidance "Volume *" or "Voice guidance will be stopped" is given; when the volume adjustment button is pushed while voice guidance is in progress, the voice guidance is repeated once more at the adjusted volume so that the volume can be checked.
Even when voice guidance is stopped, guidance is given at volume 1 when an error occurs.
